TC-22/S04.title: AI Check, Hospital 5 fixtures on dev (live model): 0/5 pass — dictated results do not close their tasks, diet and peak-flow orders add no task, the weight task is never harvested
TC-22/S04.detail: Dev, build 43c38a4f, agent unit T22-S04 (rows 'QA TC-22-S04 …' deleted after). All calls Haiku 4.5, no fallback. Per fixture (pre-round harvest → Save & Extract): H-01 harvest made 'Follow up BMP', 'PT evaluation' — no weight task (U1); Save & Extract closed both (BMP closed this time) but added no diet task (U5); the re-tap closed and added nothing (U3 pass). H-02 harvest 3/3; 'Magnesium came back at 2.1' left 'Follow up the magnesium level' open (U2); echo closed; furosemide conditional and troponin monitoring tasks added (U5/U7 pass). H-03 harvest 3/3; 'Blood cultures are negative at 48 hours' left the culture task open (U2); ID closed; MRI conditional and 'Trend the white count daily' added. H-04 harvest made 2/3 (no weight task, U1); 'Morning chemistry is back' left 'follow up BMP' open (U2); PT closed; no renal-diet conditional task (U5); potassium recheck added (U7 pass); 'We'll recheck her weight in two weeks' at the bedside added no task either (so the weight recheck is on no list). H-05 harvest 3/3; 'Sputum culture grew normal flora' left the culture task open (U2); pulmonology closed; oxygen conditional added; no peak-flow task (U7). No retraction became a task in any fixture (U6 pass), nothing duplicated, nothing urgent. Count for 3.2 with S05: 0/5 here. Known causes: D4 (the task prompt's whitelist drops conditional and monitoring orders outside consult / medication / imaging / labs) and the UAT's phrasing-sensitivity gap (Q7) for the result closures. Grading against EVALUATION_FRAMEWORK.md (U9 part, TFA-94229 in progress) and U10 are todo.
